subject: gk
question: What is the percentage of concession on fares provided to women on HRTC buses under the ‘Nari ko Naman’ scheme launched by the Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**50%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The '**Nari Ko Naman**' scheme was launched by the Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh,** Jai Ram Thakur, in 2022.**
 
• The 'Nari Ko Naman' scheme was officially launched on** March 8, 2022,** coinciding with **International Women's Day.**
 
• The scheme is implemented by the** Department of Women and Child Development, Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• The **primary beneficiaries** of the scheme are **women** of HP from various backgrounds, including **those excelling in fields such as education, healthcare, arts, sports, and social work.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Himachal Pradesh is located in the northern part of India, **bordered by Punjab to the west, Haryana to the south, Uttarakhand to the southeast, and Tibet (China) to the east.**
 
• The** total area** of Himachal Pradesh is approximately **55,538 square kilometers **(21,495 square miles).
 
• As per the 2011 Census, the** population **of Himachal Pradesh was approximately** 6.8 million.**
 
• Himachal Pradesh is divided into **12 districts.**
 
• The population **density** is about **123 persons per square kilometer.**
 
• The** literacy rate** in Himachal Pradesh stands at about** 83.78%** (as per the 2011 Census).
 
• The state has a **bicameral legislature** consisting of the Vidhan Sabha (Legislative Assembly) and Vidhan Parishad (Legislative Council).
